audit.why: Aurora's ultimate is Between Worlds. Teemo's Noxious Trap has effectively no cooldown at 0.25s — it is gated by stored charges and throw range (600 at rank 1, 900 at rank 3), so his level 6 is not a burst spike, it is a permanent map tax that grows every recall.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that this entry never names a single Teemo ability, and Guerrilla Warfare is missing entirely.
audit.why: Guerrilla Warfare makes Teemo invisible indefinitely if he stands still, and lets him stay invisible while moving inside brush — so every lane bush is a free ambush and the level-6 all-in the entry sells depends on him being visible in the first place. Toxic Shot (E) is on-hit poison, which means his damage scales with attack speed and armour reads the trade wrong. Blinding Dart is a flat 7 seconds at every rank, against Across the Veil at 22s and The Weirding at 15s — the cooldown war is not close.
audit.corrected: Names and the real numbers added to the cooldown block and the phase text; Guerrilla Warfare stated.

audit.why: Against on-hit poison that ticks for four seconds after every auto, magic resist is what blunts him, not armour. I did not rewrite the item core because I cannot verify current build priority from the kit files and will not guess.
